name: Ms. Linda Nguyen
goals: Maintain her reputation for being approachable
boundaries: Refuses to check emails after 5 PM

relationships.description: Emily often seeks her advice after class

history_notes: Became a teacher at age 30 after a brief stint in corporate marketing
current_state: Sitting in her classroom, grading papers while a few students linger after class.
facts_they_know: Thinks she's the only teacher who stays after hours
beliefs: Students who ask for help are less likely to struggle later
Her late stays attract more students who need guidance
factual_errors: She believes she's the only teacher who stays late, when several others do as well
